description: Automatic background fetching performed by Next.js when a <Link> component enters the viewport so route transitions resolve immediately on click.
A Client Component hook from next/navigation that returns the current URL pathname without query parameters for active navigation states.
A Client Component hook returning a read-only URLSearchParams object used to read and clone query parameters without clobbering other filters.
A Client Component hook providing imperative navigation methods including push, replace, back, forward, and refresh.
Server-side navigation helpers that throw a control-flow signal to issue a temporary 307/303 redirect or a cached 308 permanent redirect.
